policy: This is the only ChatGPT Project Source file required. All other research state, protocols, trigger definitions, micro-packets, topic packets, claims, experiments, reports and provenance remain in GitHub and are loaded on demand. Command/status membership is always resolved from PROJECT_COMMAND_REGISTRY.json and STATUS_FOOTER_PROTOCOL.md so the visible status box cannot silently retain a stale trigger list.
legacy_policy: Legacy sentinels may remain in GitHub for history/recovery but must not outrank PROJECT_SOURCE_SINGLE_BOOTSTRAP_V2.txt when both are visible.
